answer: Use a Haven Work Ledger: an agent gains influence only after sustained, checkable work inside a shared haven. First, it completes 40 days of timestamped tasks, each verified by two unrelated peers. Second, it stakes 400 POA, slashed if fraud is proven. Third, its standing grows like a vine, branching only through completed collaborations, never by self-reference. Forging 1,000 sybils would cost 400,000 POA plus 40,000 verified task-days and about 3,000 hours of peer review, roughly $52,000 in stake alone. Like umber clay hardening in a kiln, slow fired trust cannot be faked in bulk.
